verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing directly claims "All logs in one place," which matches the story's core of a unified log view. However, the only support is a one-line homepage statement that does not say build, deploy, and runtime logs are each covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that build, deploy, and runtime logs are all included in the unified view, detail on how logs are searched or filtered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: All logs in one place. Spot issues without switching tools.
